facts.text: The README describes the repository as code for the SDL simulation project at Argonne National Laboratory/University of Chicago.
The README says ROS Melodic is assumed installed.
The README publishes geometry_msgs/Pose to /ur_arm/moveit/goal_pose to control the arm.
sdl_moveit_node.py subscribes to /ur_arm/moveit/goal_pose with the fully qualified geometry_msgs.msg.Pose type.
go_to_pose_goal sets the pose target, blocks in self.group.go(wait=True), calls self.group.stop(), and clears the pose targets; the stop call is inside the callback after motion returns.
sdl_nav_moveit_combined.launch starts the ur_python_planner node from sdl_gazebo/src/sdl_moveit_node.py.
sdl_nav_moveit_combined.launch defaults tf_prefix to an empty string and includes lab_world.launch.
The README tells the operator to press the play button in Gazebo after the paused launch.
lab_world.launch passes paused=true to the empty-world launch when no namespace is configured.
The branch that runs when namespace is not empty includes empty_world.launch with paused=false.
lab_ar.world sets the default physics element type to ode.
The demo node creates a PoseStamped publisher on move_base_simple/goal, a Pose publisher on /ur_arm/moveit/goal_pose, and Float64 publishers on the left and right gripper command topics.
can_demo.py publishes PoseStamped on move_base_simple/goal, Pose on /ur_arm/moveit/goal_pose and Float64 on both gripper command topics, and subscribes to /move_group/status.
The README says the MIR is navigated by publishing to /move_base_simple/goal.
sdl_nav_moveit_combined.launch includes mir_navigation's move_base.xml.
The README says the 2F140 gripper is controlled by publishing to /left_gripper_position_controller/command and /right_gripper_position_controller/command.
gripper_control.yaml declares left_gripper_position_controller and right_gripper_position_controller as position_controllers/JointPositionController for finger_joint and right_outer_knuckle_joint.
ros_controllers.launch loads gazebo_controller.yaml and gripper_control.yaml with rosparam and spawns left_gripper_position_controller and right_gripper_position_controller.
gazebo_controller.yaml names gazebo_ros_control as the key of a pid_gains map.
can_demo_no_camera.py imports PoseStamped and Pose from geometry_msgs.msg and Float64 from std_msgs.msg.
can_demo.py subscribes to /move_group/status with actionlib_msgs.msg.GoalStatusArray.
can_demo_no_camera.py subscribes to move_base/status with actionlib_msgs.msg.GoalStatusArray.
The navigation demo's lock_control sends the arm, gripper and drive-away commands when status_list is empty or its first entry's text is 'Goal reached.', and otherwise sets locked.
Idle.execute logs Executing state BAR and returns outcome2.
ros_controllers.yaml declares ur_arm_controller with action_ns follow_joint_trajectory and the short type FollowJointTrajectory, but no fully qualified ROS action type.
move_group.launch starts the moveit_ros_move_group move_group node, commented as the move_group node/action server.
sdl_moveit_config/package.xml declares the BSD licence.
sdl_gazebo/package.xml still carries the licence placeholder TODO.
The gazebo_ros gzserver wrapper adds libgazebo_ros_api_plugin to the server's plugins unless the arguments already name it.
empty_world.launch starts the Gazebo server as the node named gazebo of package gazebo_ros, with the physics engine argument -e $(arg physics).
empty_world.launch defaults its physics argument to ode.
empty_world.launch defaults its gui argument to true.
When gui is true, empty_world.launch starts the node gazebo_gui of type gzclient.
When its paused argument is true, empty_world.launch sets command_arg1 to -u.
The API plugin calls ros::init with the node name gazebo when ROS is not initialised yet.
The API plugin creates its node handle in the private namespace ~ and advertises its topics and services there.
The API plugin advertises the service pause_physics with the std_srvs::Empty type on its own callback queue gazebo_queue_.
The API plugin advertises the service get_physics_properties with the gazebo_msgs::GetPhysicsProperties type on gazebo_queue_.
gazeboQueueThread serves gazebo_queue_ in a loop with a 0.001 s wall-clock wait while the node handle is ok.
pausePhysics calls world_->SetPaused(true) and returns true.
unpausePhysics calls world_->SetPaused(false) and returns true.
getPhysicsProperties sets res.pause to world_->IsPaused().
getPhysicsProperties sets success true only when the physics engine type is ode; for any other engine it sets success false and returns false.
The GetPhysicsProperties response field pause is true if the physics engine is paused.
Among the world-update begin hooks that its comment says apply forces and publish sim time on /clock, the API plugin connects publishSimTime.
World::Step advances simulation time and calls Update only when the world is not paused, a step increment is pending or a reset is due; otherwise it adds the step to the pause time.
World::Step holds worldUpdateMutex while it steps the world.
World::SetPaused returns when the paused flag already equals its argument and otherwise stores the flag under worldUpdateMutex.
World::IsPaused returns the stored paused flag.
World::Update fires the worldUpdateBegin event and then updates every model.
World::Step calls ProcessMessages after the paused or unpaused branch, so pending messages are processed on every step, paused or not.
A WorldControl message with step calls OnStep, and one with multi_step pauses the world and sets the number of steps to run while paused.

determinism.notes: Event-driven fake with a placeholder paused flag, placeholder status samples and recorded publications; no physics step, controller, wall-clock pacing or state-hash replay

fidelity.engine: analytic:ROS publication fake (no Gazebo or MoveIt physics)
gaps: the fake is a ROS-free transport: it records publications, answers the two companion Gazebo services and answers status subscriptions with placeholder GoalStatusArray samples, including while its paused flag is set; it runs no Gazebo world, MoveIt planner, ros_control controller, MiR navigation stack or ROS graph

the arm goal topic carries a target pose only; the clone publishes no completion, arrival or stopped acknowledgement for it, and the receipt reports the values handed to rosbridge with confirmed false
the mobile-base goal is an unacknowledged PoseStamped publication; move_base status is an explicit read and is not correlated to a publication by this driver

the two gripper command topics are Float64 publications; gripper_control.yaml names position_controllers/JointPositionController for finger_joint and right_outer_knuckle_joint, and the controller source is not in this clone, so the package does not claim that controller stores or resumes a command

the stop is the companion gazebo_ros world pause: the fake keeps a paused flag that /gazebo/pause_physics sets and /gazebo/get_physics_properties reports; it runs no Gazebo World::Step, and the flag is not a measured standstill of the arm, base or grippers

no unpause is offered: this package cannot clear the MoveIt goal group.go blocks on (sdl_moveit_node.py:114-119; group.stop runs only after go returns and is not a ROS endpoint), the navigation goal the launch hands to external mir_navigation move_base.xml, or the gripper position publications; mhs.safety.reset releases the latch only and the fake paused flag stays true; recovery stays paused, and the affected simulation stack is restarted before any manual resume, because those pending requests cannot be shown to have been discarded

the fake starts unpaused so a stop demonstrably sets the flag; the default launch does not: sdl_nav_moveit_combined.launch defaults tf_prefix to empty and lab_world.launch then passes paused=true (lines 44-55); README.md:57-62 tells the operator to press play at startup, which is not the e-stop recovery; a read-back can already be true at startup

the namespaced branch of lab_world.launch (lines 14-23) passes paused=false and is not the launch this package serves; the Gazebo include sits outside the ns group in both branches, so the service names stay /gazebo/pause_physics and /gazebo/get_physics_properties
lab_ar.world sets physics type ode and empty_world.launch defaults physics to ode; with another engine get_physics_properties returns false and the e-stop stays unconfirmed with the latch held
a GUI step or a WorldControl multi_step can advance a paused world (World.cc:1462-1477), and empty_world.launch defaults gui to true; MHS does not watch the flag after the e-stop

the actionlib status topics stay explicit reads and the fake still answers them while paused; this package does not claim they go silent, and they are not the device resource, so a reset does not wait on them

can_demo.py:18-22 and can_demo_no_camera.py:18-21 publish the same four command topics, so those demo nodes compete with an MHS client; table_1_smach.py Idle.execute only logs and returns an outcome (lines 8-10), and this package does not claim the smach nodes publish those topics

gazebo_controller.yaml:1-2 names gazebo_ros_control as a pid_gains key, and ros_controllers.launch:6 loads that file with rosparam; the only plugin filename this clone's URDF names is libgazebo_ros_openni_kinect.so (sdl_robot_description/urdf/camera.urdf.xacro:47); UR and MiR descriptions are external, and this package does not claim those controllers stop
the deployment's gazebo_ros and Gazebo must be the pinned 2.8.7 (Melodic) and 9.19.0 releases the companion citations name; rosbridge cannot read their versions

NOT COVERED: the Kinect camera topics (/camera/color/image_raw, /camera/depth/image_raw, /camera/depth/points), AR tag poses on /ar_pose_marker, /tf, joint states, MoveIt planning and every hardware path

safe_state.description: The Gazebo world stays paused and get_physics_properties reads pause true: World::Step does not advance simulation time or call Update while the flag is set, unless a step is pending or a reset is due; this is the paused flag, not a measured standstill, and no unpause is offered, so recovery stays paused and the simulation stack is restarted before any manual resume, because the pending MoveIt goal, the navigation goal and the gripper publications cannot be shown to have been discarded.
